UNSAFE USE: the unterminated buffer is handed to C-string parsers (sscanf) that scan until NUL, reading past the end of the allocation. CONSEQUENCE: out-of-bounds heap read (KASAN slab-OOB, info leak / crash). Search guidance: grep call sites of memdup_user followed by string parsers; kmalloc/copy_from_user with exact user length then string ops; copy helpers lacking a terminator byte; and verify the fix primitive (memdup_user_nul / strndup_user / len+1 allocation). BRANCHES: branch1=debugfs-write-memdup-sscanf - debugfs (and analogous debug-control) write file_operations handlers across drivers that memdup_user or kmalloc+copy_from_user an attacker-sized buffer and pass it to sscanf/simple_strtoul-style parsers without NUL termination; branch2=sysfs-store-attr-terminator - sysfs ->store() attribute callbacks (device/driver/bus/class/module attrs) that copy_from_user into exact- or fixed-size buffers and then use string parsers or strcmp/strlen/strchr on possibly-unterminated data; branch3=proc-config-write-unterminated - /proc, configfs, and other textual control-file write handlers that copy user data of attacker-chosen length and consume it with string functions assuming termination; branch4=ioctl-sock-usercopy-string - ioctl, setsockopt/getsockopt, netlink, and char-device fops paths that copy_from_user into variable-length buffers and then use string helpers (sscanf, strtoul, strcmp, strchr, strscpy) on the unterminated result.'

  "patch": "commit 13d0cecb4626fae67c00c84d3c7851f6b62f7df3
Author: Bui Quang Minh <minhquangbui99@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Apr 24 21:44:20 2024 +0700

    scsi: bfa: Ensure the copied buf is NUL terminated
    
    Currently, we allocate a nbytes-sized kernel buffer and copy nbytes from
    userspace to that buffer. Later, we use sscanf on this buffer but we don't
    ensure that the string is terminated inside the buffer, this can lead to
    OOB read when using sscanf. Fix this issue by using memdup_user_nul instead
    of memdup_user.
    
    Fixes: 9f30b674759b ("bfa: replace 2 kzalloc/copy_from_user by memdup_user")
    Signed-off-by: Bui Quang Minh <minhquangbui99@gmail.com>
    Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240424-fix-oob-read-v2-3-f1f1b53a10f4@gmail.com
    Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/bfa/bfad_debugfs.c b/drivers/scsi/bfa/bfad_debugfs.c
index 52db147d9979..f6dd077d47c9 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/bfa/bfad_debugfs.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/bfa/bfad_debugfs.c
@@ -250,7 +250,7 @@ bfad_debugfs_write_regrd(struct file *file, const char __user *buf,
